title: Counterintuitiveness is little reason to think a theory false

statements.text: Special relativity, natural selection and quantum mechanics are counterintuitive and accepted. That most people in one culture are inclined to think panpsychism false gives little reason to think it false, if the view does theoretical work.

sources.quote: It is hard to see why the fact that most Westerners living today happen to be pre-theoretically inclined to think panpsychism false constitutes a reason to think that it is false.
'common sense intuition' should have little sway if we have a view which pulls its weight theoretically
